$comment: Compose Glimmer as a UI Builder palette. Component records are discovered from the real Glimmer call sites rendered by the catalog; this file owns only catalog-level policy.

wasm.reason: The builder canvas does not yet link this repository's CMP Glimmer port, so components are represented by catalog-aware placeholders.

native.reason: Generated Compose rendered against the released AndroidX Glimmer AAR through Robolectric, the same lane used by the catalog.

glimmer/sticker.excluded: The catalog's own preview frame is not a Glimmer library component.
